threads.body: The Agno runtime used by both conformance scenarios changes here, but this implementation's generated `data.json` is not updated. Regenerate it with the repository's documented `otel-conformance scenarios/gen-ai/python/agno/opentelemetry-agno --report-only` command and commit any resulting output; otherwise the checked-in conformance record still represents Agno 2.9.0 and CI will reject a runtime/output diff.
